No git commands were run; the Mac publish agent handles commit and push.
drivers: Futures are modestly lower after Thursday's AI rout, when the Nasdaq-100 fell 2.9% and the S&P 500 1.2% (Dow flat) on fears AI spending has peaked: Meta kept capex guidance vague while planning new share issuance, Tesla cut its capex plan, and Nvidia's Jensen Huang spoke of a 'scarcity of capital' for AI infrastructure. Chips are steadier this morning (SOXX +0.3%, MU +0.9%, SK hynix +3.6%), leaving S&P 500 futures −0.4% and Nasdaq-100 futures −0.2%. The day's biggest story is a Bloomberg report that SpaceX wants access to at least 80,000 US cell sites to build a fourth carrier: Crown Castle, American Tower and SBA are up 10–14%, while AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile are down about 5%. Oil keeps climbing (WTI above $101, Brent near a five-month high) after Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia and reports of possible new US/Israeli strikes on Iran; Europe is lower (DAX −1.0%), Asia mixed (Nikkei −0.3%, Hang Seng +0.7%). The 10-year yield is near 4.98% and the VIX near 20; flash PMIs and final Michigan sentiment are due before mid-morning, and the Fed is in its quiet period ahead of the Oct 27–28 FOMC.
